gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-syriac-eas: Approachable from the first line, Redux spreads its letters wide and swings into every curve with a visible run-up. Noto Sans Syriac Eastern follows with tall lowercase and curves that stop well short of each other, so a longer passage moves along without feeling crowded.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-syriac-wes: Redux leads with a big visible entrance into every curve, spaced wide, with a restrained thick-thin rhythm. Noto Sans Syriac Western is dense and low in contrast.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Noto Sans Tagalog reads plainly, its middle zone dominating each line while the curves keep generous gaps.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Noto Sans Tagbanwa fills most of its height with lowercase and keeps its curves open, with clear gaps all round. Redux, spaced wide, adds a tempered thick-thin variation above it.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Wide, geometric, softly brushed. Noto Sans Tai Le tapers its ink strokes out before they touch and barely steps from capitals to lowercase, so a longer passage runs smoothly beneath Redux.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Redux spaces its rounded letters wide, thickening slightly at the sides. Its strength is that visible entrance into each curve, while Noto Sans Tai Tham does its best work with chalk-board lowercase crowding toward the capital line.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Short ascenders and a tall x-height give this body a compact, approachable read. Noto Sans Tai Viet pulls its terminals back from the curves, which sits well against the wide-spaced Redux with its slimmer horizontals.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-takri: Wide, geometric, slightly pinched. Make Redux small and its spaced letters and curve entrances lose their drama, while Noto Sans Takri, with its high-waisted lowercase and unclosed curves, would feel oversized if made large.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Redux spaces its letters wide and enters each curve with a visible lead-in, its mild stress keeping every stroke solid. Noto Sans Tamil sits beneath it, looking magnified.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supp: That visible entrance into every curve, set among wide-spaced letters, is what defines Redux. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement answers with round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky.
